facts.text: Physically based rendering computes what a sensor sees using the physics of light and materials; a BRDF or BSDF mathematically describes how a surface sends incoming energy out in each direction.
facts.quote: Physically based rendering computes what a sensor sees from the real physics of light and materials, and a BRDF or BSDF is the mathematical description of how a given surface sends incoming energy back out in each direction.
